english: The book that I read yesterday was very interesting.
chinese: 我昨天读的那本书非常有趣。
soundmark: /ðə bʊk ðæt aɪ red ˈjestədeɪ wɒz ˈveri ˈɪntrəstɪŋ/

english: The girl who is sitting there is my classmate.
chinese: 坐在那边的女孩是我的同学。
soundmark: /ðə ɡɜːrl huː ɪz ˈsɪtɪŋ ðeər ɪz maɪ ˈklɑːsmeɪt/

english: This is the house where I grew up.
soundmark: /ðɪs ɪz ðə haʊs weər aɪ ɡruː ʌp/

english: I will never forget the day when we first met.
chinese: 我永远不会忘记我们初次见面的那天。
soundmark: /aɪ wɪl ˈnevər fərˈɡet ðə deɪ wen wiː fɜːrst met/

english: The reason why he was late is still unknown.
chinese: 他迟到的原因至今不明。
soundmark: /ðə ˈriːzn waɪ hiː wɒz leɪt ɪz stɪl ʌnˈnəʊn/

english: He is the man whose wife is a doctor.
chinese: 他就是那个妻子是医生的男人。
soundmark: /hiː ɪz ðə mæn huːz waɪf ɪz ə ˈdɒktər/

grammar.label: 定语从句
grammar.text: whose引导的定语从句表所属

english: Everything that he said is true.
The city in which I was born has changed a lot.
chinese: 我出生的城市变化很大。
soundmark: /ðə ˈsɪti ɪn wɪtʃ aɪ wɒz bɔːrn hæz tʃeɪndʒd ə lɒt/

english: Those who work hard will succeed.
The house, which was built in 1900, needs repairing.
chinese: 那栋建于1900年的房子需要修缮。
soundmark: /ðə haʊs wɪtʃ wɒz bɪlt ɪn ˌnaɪnˈtiːn ˈhʌndrəd niːdz rɪˈpeərɪŋ/

english: I know a restaurant where you can get delicious food.
chinese: 我知道一家能吃到美食的餐厅。
soundmark: /aɪ nəʊ ə ˈrestrɒnt weər juː kæn ɡet dɪˈlɪʃəs fuːd/

english: The student whom the teacher praised is my brother.
chinese: 老师表扬的那个学生是我弟。
soundmark: /ðə ˈstjuːdnt huːm ðə ˈtiːtʃər preɪzd ɪz maɪ ˈbrʌðər/

english: Do you remember the time when we used to play together?
chinese: 你还记得我们一起玩的那段时光吗？
soundmark: /duː juː rɪˈmembər ðə taɪm wen wiː juːzd tuː pleɪ təˈɡeðər/

english: As is known to all, the earth moves around the sun.
chinese: 众所周知，地球绕着太阳转。
soundmark: /æz ɪz nəʊn tuː ɔːl ðə ɜːrθ muːvz əˈraʊnd ðə sʌn/

english: There is nothing that can stop us from achieving our goal.
chinese: 没有什么能阻止我们达成目标。
soundmark: /ðeər ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ ðæt kæn stɒp ʌs frɒm əˈtʃiːvɪŋ aʊər ɡəʊl/
